command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0098/literal.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input (LF, trailing newline): `  .text` / `  lui a0, 0` / `  lui a0, 1` / `  lui a0, 0xfffff`. The three words are `37 05 00 00`, `37 15 00 00` and `37 f5 ff ff`: `imm20` at 31-12, `rd` at 11-7, `opcode = 0110111`. llvm-mc requires the literal in [0, 1048575] and rejects `-1` as well as `0x100000`, so the definition marks the slot `signed: false`; the measured domain is the whole 20-bit field. There is no fixup: this fixture covers the form's field, not the %hi/%lo pair.
source: RISC-V UDB I/lui.yaml, `location` 31-12; measured operand range from llvm-mc 23.1.2
